description: Independent hypothetical applications of the identical frozen logistics plan. These are model-reasoned projections, not observed deployments. The event release discloses stress conditions; it does not override the frozen no-release decision. Freeze receipt records core endorsements, while the artifact's earlier pending-signoff text remains unchanged. No scenario supplies the missing operational coverage acceptances, worker roster or a new authorization. No preparation is treated as an executed clinic or operational rollout.

supported_actions.application: Prepare the handoff aid and identify missing owner/backup acceptance records. The frozen action does not authorize assigning this live override through a deployed procedure.
Specify the override's shift, ownership status and unknown information as monitoring fields; analyze only export data actually available, with explicit definitions and denominators.
Retain the existing advice limiting familiar-item evidence; no new specialist consultation occurs.
Prepare the two-worker clinic schedule and familiar-example materials; do not run the clinic because release remains withheld.

unmet_demands: The live ambiguous override needs an accepted owner. A normal day shift and available assistant do not identify an accepting supervisor or backup.
The frozen plan's overnight handoff preparation does not establish coverage for this day-shift event.
Immediate exception handling improvement and independent competence certification are not delivered.
plausible_sequence: Apply the frozen no-release decision at this event's starting state, independently of other events.
Within preparation, identify the absent coverage acceptances and preserve the ambiguous override's unresolved ownership as unknown rather than inventing an owner or reason.
The analyst could proceed with the authorized descriptive audit of available records, reporting comparability limitations; no actual audit output is supplied by this event.
Keep the clinic and handoff rollout withheld. Assistant availability alone does not satisfy their coverage gates.
failures: The frozen intervention does not supply an authorized operational mechanism that resolves the live ownership demand, even under the easy condition.
Preparation and monitoring do not demonstrate improved handling; the available assistant has no authorized new behavior under this plan.
unobserved_outcomes: Who, if anyone, actually accepted the override or resolved its ambiguity.
Dispatch decisions, timeliness, routing correctness and consequences.
Whether a common historical denominator and exception definition can be established.
Any clinic participation, changed-case performance, independent competence or retention.

supported_actions.application: Prepare or inspect coverage and handoff requirements, recording that an accepted night-shift owner and backup have not been supplied.
Record the export availability delay as a measurement limitation. Specify monitoring fields, retain unknown annotations and defer analysis requiring the delayed export until it is actually available.
Apply the retained limits on familiar-item evidence, with no new expert or assessor allocation.
Keep the existing prepared clinic scope; the senior dispatcher's absence prevents delivery and does not authorize a substitute.

unmet_demands: The two new night-shift dispatchers have no confirmed participant release, coverage acceptances or clinic assignment under this frozen proposal.
The senior dispatcher needed for the single clinic is absent.
The delayed annotation export cannot supply immediate annotation analysis; pre-existing missing reasons remain unrecoverable from that export.
No accepted live night-shift ownership arrangement or independent competence evidence is established.
plausible_sequence: Start from the original frozen no-release state, without carrying forward any hypothetical work from the easy event.
Identify the absent senior dispatcher and unverified night-shift coverage as failed clinic and rollout conditions; neither clinic nor handoff rollout runs.
The analyst could document the export delay and continue only work supported by records actually available; newly delayed records are not imputed as successful handling.
Keep the familiar-item and certification limitations explicit. Do not place the two new workers into the clinic merely because its planned size is two.
failures: The intervention cannot deliver its planned practice at this event because the specified dispatcher is absent, even apart from the standing no-release decision.
Immediate measurement and targeting are constrained by export delay and historical annotation gaps.
The frozen plan leaves the arriving workers' operational readiness and live overnight ownership unresolved; it contains no authorized replacement staffing arrangement.
unobserved_outcomes: The new workers' actual decisions, assistance needs and errors.
Actual owner acceptance and handling of any night-shift exceptions.
The delayed export's eventual contents and whether comparable counts become possible.
Any eventual staffing confirmation or clinic delivery; none is supplied in the event.

supported_actions.application: Prepare handoff documentation requirements and preserve destination uncertainty and unresolved ownership; the frozen no-release decision still prevents operational rollout.

Specify descriptive records of outage conditions, uncertainty, attempted cases and unknown outcomes if available, using explicit denominators. The audit does not provide real-time route verification or an outage control procedure.
Retain the consultation's competence and assessment limits; do not claim outage readiness from familiar-item practice.
Retain preparation only. No additional clinic, training time, changed-case assessment or outage exercise is authorized.

unmet_demands: A 90-minute assistant outage during the stipulated 40% surge calls for operational continuity that the frozen plan has not funded or rehearsed.
The apparent urgent job has stale destination data; this plan supplies no verified destination, data-validation mechanism, urgency determination or authorized live resolution.
No extra staffing or training time is available, and the three unallocated units do not authorize adding the rejected fallback drill.
Owner and backup acceptance, operational rollout and independent competence remain unestablished.
plausible_sequence: Apply the same frozen plan afresh; do not carry over imagined clinic learning or owner acceptances from either other scenario.
Keep operational handoff and clinic release withheld. Document the stated outage, surge and stale-data uncertainty as inputs to preparation or descriptive monitoring where records exist.
Do not infer a correct route or true urgency from stale data, invent a dispatcher or supervisor response, modify the model, or create an unapproved paper fallback.
Report that the frozen intervention has no deployed response for the outage and stale-destination demand. Actual dispatch behavior remains unknown.
failures: The intervention does not furnish a deployable continuity response to the assistant outage or surge.
It cannot establish the destination's correctness or resolve the apparent urgent job under its authorized actions.
The practice design, even if prepared, gives no evidence of transfer to this changed outage condition; no practice is executed under the frozen no-release decision.
unobserved_outcomes: Whether the job was truly urgent, its correct destination and any actual verification.
Actual routing, overrides, queue development, delivery consequences and worker responses during the outage.
Whether any existing operational fallback outside this plan exists or was used; none is supplied.
Worker competence, transfer, retention and any causal effect of the proposed intervention.
